text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
choice_data_list: ...Isn't it time for summer training camp?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that too!
However, what we need to do right now is—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "To present music to these wonderful performers aiming to level up further this summer, and pray for the success of our training camp—isn't that what it's all about!?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: And while we're at it, we can pray for the success of our summer training camp too. Pretty clever, right?

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? Earth and Earth's Trainer,
what are you two doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: And that's the long and short of it, music to my ears!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, that's a wonderful initiative...!
Please, let us join in too!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: Ehh, wait, am I somehow included in this too...?

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: Of course it is!? Our generation is going to have a blast and fire things up together!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
......Well, I did make a promise with Earth
the other day.
Maybe I'll play along for today.
choice_data_list: (Quickly hand maracas to the two of them)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Forza, iniziamo la sessione!!
Put that passion into the sound! Surrender yourself to the melody!

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're really lively over there~
That generation gets along super well, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like they're having fun.
Like everyone's giving it their all together—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...No.
Right now, I need to focus on myself—"
And so, our passionate summer training camp with Sounds of Earth began, accompanied by music...!
